messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] High error rate detected: inference-runtime returning 5xx/timeouts across multiple regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1). Spike started ~T-3m. Auto-page: @oncall-elena :rotating_light:

oncall-elena: seeing a surge of 502/504s, I'm on it — standing up triage now.

sre-jordan: joining the channel. what do logs show? any OOMs or segfaults yet?

eng-runtime-amy: we’re seeing a rapid increase in kernel OOMs and a few segfaults on model-runner pods, appears during KV cache writes. sample log excerpt:

```
model-runner[pid=21456]: alloc failed: out-of-memory
stack: 0x7f9a... 0x400f...  kt:quant_attention+0x1a3
```

support-raj: customer-impact: ~2.4% of requests returning 502, a handful of PLG customers in EU hitting timeouts. tickets coming in.

oncall-elena: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized variant, 2) scale spare capacity up, 3) limit large-batch jobs. Jordan, can you trigger fallback policy and scale?

sre-jordan: triggering fallback routing now, bumping capacity pool +3 nodes in us-west-2. running `kubectl -n inference scale deploy model-runner --replicas=12`

ops-liam: FYI autoscaler was paused for maintenance in eu-west-1, resuming it now (which should let us recover without manual scale).

eng-runtime-amy: pushing hot toggle to runtime to disable aggressive KV prefetch on the recent quant kernels. rolling canary to 20% traffic.

oncall-elena: canary up. early metrics: error rate on canary traffic down from 18% -> 6%.

support-raj: prepping customer comms. will send a proactive note once stabilization is confirmed.

sre-jordan: extending rollout to other canary groups, avoid full rollback for now. enabling eviction policy for long-running large-batch jobs to free memory.

IncidentBot: ACTIONS LOGGED: fallback routing enabled; capacity scale +3; runtime KV-prefetch toggle canary deployed.

eng-runtime-amy: found a reproducible segfault in quant_attention path, opened internal ticket with stack + minimal repro: https://git.internal/r/1234

customer-success-olivia: drafting heads-up for top affected accounts, will send with mitigation summary.

oncall-elena: incident severity: P1 (partial outage affecting subset). root cause likely a regression in quant kernel combined with autoscaler being paused. handoff plan: Jordan remains POC for 2h then hand to night-sre.

sre-jordan: handoff note for night: actions taken = (+3 nodes), fallback routing, KV-prefetch disabled, evictions enabled. follow-ups: analyze kernel memory accounting and add guardrails to autoscaler maintenance flow.

ops-liam: autoscaler resumed and verifying target capacity convergence.

support-raj: customer-impact update: error rate reduced to ~0.5% after full rollout, no major accounts lost sustained requests.

oncall-elena: we’ll keep channel open for 30m, closing unless regressions occur. filing incident + postmortem tasks now.

eng-runtime-amy: follow-ups recorded: reproduce segfault & ship patched quant kernel, add regression tests for KV writes under low-memory, improve canary check for autoscaler pause state.

sre-jordan: notes + timeline saved to incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/1769955555

oncall-elena: thanks team — great quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
